title: Senior Power BI Developer
job_description:
Job Title: Power BI Pro / Sigma Developer
Location: Remote
Duration: 3-6 Months
Type: Contract

Job Summary:
Looking for a Power BI Pro with hands-on Sigma Computing experience to support a 3-month project converting Power BI reports and dashboards to Sigma.

Responsibilities:

Convert Power BI reports and dashboards into Sigma Computing.
Recreate visualizations, formatting, filters, and calculations in Sigma.
Validate converted dashboards for accuracy and consistency.
Troubleshoot migration and formatting issues.

Required Skills:

Strong Power BI experience.
Hands-on Sigma Computing experience.
Experience with Sigma dashboard/report formatting and visualization.
Strong BI, reporting, and troubleshooting skills.

Pay: $65.00 - $75.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Work Location: Remote
